The '''2004–05 Ekstraklasa''' is the 79th season of the [[List of Polish football champions|Polish Football Championship]] and the 71st season of the [[Ekstraklasa]], [[Polish football league system|the top Polish professional league]] for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in [[1927 Ekstraklasa|1927]].

==Overview==
14 teams competed in the 2004-05 season. [[Wisła Kraków]] won the championship.
